get.description: Searches Fragella (cached for 30 days in the database, counted against the monthly budget).
Fragella requests used this month against Fragella:MonthlyRequestLimit.

post.description: multipart/form-data with one 'file' (JPEG, PNG or WebP, max 5 MB). Returns the URL to use in a variant's images.

get.description: Orders per status for the same filters as the list (status tabs).
Order counts (completed, refused, cancelled, open) and the last 10 orders of a customer.
Per courier for one Kosovo day: expected (shipped), collected, fees, net received, still at the courier.

post.description: Manual COD booking, e.g. for a statement line with a wrong amount (note required when the amount differs).
Needs an issued sale receipt; otherwise 409, or overrideMissingReceipt = true with a reason (logged).

get.description: Daily handover list. format=html (default, printable) or csv.

post.description: Every parcel needs an issued sale receipt; otherwise 409 listing them, or overrideMissingReceipt = true with a reason (logged).
CSV body: tracking_number;collected_amount;fee. Re-importing the same file returns the same settlement.
Admin panel sign-in. Sets the refresh token as an HttpOnly cookie; needs the X-PerfumeShop-Client header.

delete.description: Sign out: revokes the session and deletes the cookie.

post.description: New access token from the refresh cookie (rotated).

get.description: Every template with its placeholders and, for SMS, the segment count of the sample text.

post.description: Renders the saved template, or a draft, with sample data. Nothing is saved or sent.

get.description: Notification log. Filters: status, channel, templateKey, recipient, orderNumber, from, to.

put.description: Admin. Recipients (emails) and which alerts are on: new order, failed fiscal receipt, low stock, unpaid deliveries, job failures.
